subject.title: fix(ci): include runtime resources in build artifact

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this pack-and-smoke script as the canonical `dist-runtime-build` artifact producer?
rationale: The patch directly solves the reported gap and has no concrete correctness finding, but coupling artifact publication to runtime startup smoke is an operational ownership choice that automation should not make.

options.title: Adopt with merge-result proof
options.body: Merge after the exact merge result passes the complete artifact producer and extracted-runtime smoke.

options.title: Separate the smoke gate
options.body: Pause and redesign if packaging and runtime startup proof should be independently owned CI surfaces.

recommendation.title: Adopt with merge-result proof
recommendation.body: Merge after the exact merge result passes the complete artifact producer and extracted-runtime smoke.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored and proved the contract-owning implementation and is assigned to the PR.
